briefdescription.para: Inst which is a def of an original reg and whose defs are already all dead after remat is saved in DeadRemats.

detaileddescription.para: The deletion of such inst is postponed till all the allocations are done, so its remat expr is always available for the remat of all the siblings of the original reg.
